messages.content: The standard room at Emerald Beach is gone now. Please recheck the ocean-view room there and the condo-style place that just opened up. Compare the complete cost, deposits, cancellation dates, beach access, and recent ratings before we decide.
I’ll recheck both for May 22 through May 30, 2027, for two adults in one room. I’ll use refundable rates and include mandatory taxes, resort charges, and cleaning fees in the totals.
Right. The flights and dates are already fixed, so this is only about lodging.

Both are available for all eight nights. Emerald Beach Resort has a refundable ocean-view king at $4,184 total: $3,312 room charge, $376 taxes, and a $496 resort fee. It requires a $523 deposit now, with the balance due at check-in. Cancellation is free through May 15; after that, the deposit is forfeited.

Sapphire Shore Condominiums has a one-bedroom king unit at $3,468 total: $2,840 lodging, $185 cleaning fee, and $443 in taxes and property charges. It requires a 50% deposit of $1,734 now and the remaining $1,734 on April 22. Cancellation is refundable through May 10 minus a $75 administrative fee; after May 10, the full amount is nonrefundable.
So the condo is $716 less overall, but much more is due now and I lose flexibility five days earlier.
Correct. Emerald costs $716 more, asks for $1,211 less today, and gives you until May 15 to cancel without penalty. Sapphire’s May 10 deadline is earlier, and even a timely cancellation costs $75.
How do the beach and review differences look? I don’t want another place where we have to schedule a shuttle or take taxis just to get to the water.

Neither requires transportation to the beach. Emerald sits directly on Lindbergh Bay, with rooms connected to the sand by the resort grounds; the ocean-view category guarantees a water-facing balcony but not a ground-floor location. Sapphire has a gated path from the condo buildings directly onto Sapphire Beach, about a two- to five-minute walk depending on the unit. The condo also has a full kitchenette, separate living area, and 780 square feet, versus Emerald’s 320-square-foot room with a mini-fridge.
What are guests saying recently, especially about upkeep and noise?

Emerald is currently 8.1 out of 10 from 1,146 reviews, with 64 reviews posted in the last six months. Recent guests consistently praise the beach and staff, while repeated complaints mention dated bathrooms, uneven housekeeping, and daytime aircraft noise. Sapphire is 8.6 out of 10 from 382 reviews, including 41 in the last six months. Its recent reviews are stronger for cleanliness, room condition, and quiet at night; recurring negatives are slower elevator service and limited on-site dining. Individual condo furnishings can vary, but this unit’s latest condition reviews are favorable.
The condo seems like the better value now that it has direct beach access. Is there any separate damage deposit or parking charge missing from that $3,468?

No parking charge applies for one vehicle, and there is no cash damage deposit. Sapphire places a temporary $300 authorization on the payment card at check-in and releases it after inspection. That hold is not part of the $3,468 charge unless damage is assessed. Wi-Fi and beach access are included; beach-chair rentals and food are extra.
Book Sapphire for both of us for all eight nights. Use the Visa ending in 6027, and I authorize the $1,734 deposit now.

Before I submit it: one one-bedroom king condo at Sapphire Shore Condominiums for two adults, checking in May 22 and checking out May 30, 2027. The complete price is $3,468. The Visa ending in 6027 will be charged $1,734 now and $1,734 on April 22. Cancellation through May 10 returns payments less $75; after that date, the reservation is nonrefundable. Shall I finalize it?

Booked. Sapphire Shore Condominiums confirmation SS4K92 covers one one-bedroom king condo for two adults from May 22 through May 30, 2027. The Visa ending in 6027 was charged $1,734; the remaining $1,734 is scheduled for April 22. The total remains $3,468, including taxes, property charges, and the cleaning fee. Cancellation is available through May 10 with a $75 fee, and the reservation becomes nonrefundable afterward. Direct beach access, the kitchenette, Wi-Fi, and parking for one vehicle are included. Your Delta flights under G6R2QK are unchanged.
